studyPolicy.description: Named primary and secondary arterials first, then numbered primary arterials, named tertiary collectors, and numbered secondary arterials. Residential/local roads and numbered tertiary collectors are map context only.
studyPolicy.classification: Highest OSM road class with at least 90 mapped meters inside Portland. Retained street names keep their full precinct-clipped geometry.

provenance.geometry: OSM ways clipped to the exact union of official district polygons per precinct, preserving holes and disconnected segments. Source vertices and clipped intersections retain full coordinate precision. No bounding-box street assignment, coordinate rounding or line simplification. Lengths measured on a sphere of mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m.

boundaries.geometry: Unmodified WGS84 official district polygons grouped by PRECINCT (CE, NO, EA) into MultiPolygons; union membership, not dissolved boundaries.
boundaries.limitation: The official layer describes police districts only within the City of Portland; boundaries are the retrieval snapshot and can change. District polygons are retained individually within each precinct.

provenance.limitations: OSM coverage and names are community maintained. Only the listed road classes are included; service roads, parking aisles, footways and other path classes are intentionally excluded. Rivers are mapped river centerlines, not water-surface polygons. The Overpass snapshot timestamp dates OSM data; the official boundary source does not expose a matching historical snapshot.
